query:
SELECT u.id, u.email, u.nickname,
            tm.team_id AS "in_team_id?",
            t.name AS "in_team_name?"
        FROM rb_user u
        LEFT JOIN rb_team_member tm ON tm.user_id = u.id AND tm.game_id = $1
        LEFT JOIN rb_team t ON t.id = tm.team_id
        WHERE $2 = ''
            OR u.email ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%'
            OR u.nickname ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%'
        ORDER BY u.id
        LIMIT 50;
